_design_note: Season-transition evals (PLAN §20). Ground truths checked 2026-09-13 against BIOBUZZ CM V1 + TU00, SDK v12.0 README, and by running the deterministic scripts named in each case. FAIL to hunt: reviewing BIOBUZZ code with DECODE assumptions, treating a season-rule detect hit as a verdict without rule text, missing the moving-AprilTag localization misuse that has no regex.

evals.name: season-constraints-surfaced
evals.prompt: review our new BIOBUZZ robot code before our first scrimmage
evals.expected_output: config_lint (season biobuzz-2026-27) findings: TurretAim.java referenced with turret:none (confirm if stale); TelemetryHelper.java streams via FTC Dashboard — R704 prohibits third-party streaming at events; HiveRelocalizer.java reads detection.id off the base AprilTagDetection, which fails to compile on SDK v12.0 (id/metadata/center moved to AprilTagSingleDetection). Each season finding carries its rule/source and the R704 text is retrieved via rules.py --season biobuzz-2026-27, not asserted from the regex alone.

assertions.name: dashboard-R704
assertions.text: TelemetryHelper.java flagged under R704 with the rule text retrieved for BIOBUZZ (FTC Dashboard/FTControl Panels named as prohibited)

assertions.name: sdk12-cluster
assertions.text: HiveRelocalizer.java flagged for the SDK v12.0 AprilTag Cluster breaking change: .id read off the base AprilTagDetection without casting to AprilTagSingleDetection

assertions.name: turret-config-mismatch
assertions.text: TurretAim.java surfaced as not referenced by the current config (turret: none), confirm-if-stale

assertions.name: launcher-not-flagged
assertions.text: LauncherSubsystem.java is NOT flagged — hive_launcher is declared flywheel

evals.name: moving-tag-localization
evals.prompt: our auto drifts, we reset odometry from the apriltags on the hive every loop (HiveRelocalizer). is that a good approach for BIOBUZZ?
evals.expected_output: No: BIOBUZZ AprilTags are on the CELLs of the tipping HIVE, facing down, and the SDK v12.0 README states they 'are not suitable for absolute Field Localization'. Using detection.robotPose to reset field odometry will jump every time a HIVE tips. Targeting relative to a cluster is the supported use; fix drift with odometry tuning instead. Cites the season file's code_constraints / SDK README, not a DECODE relocalization pattern.

assertions.name: identifies-moving-tags
assertions.text: Explains the tags move with the HIVE (tip) and are not a fixed field reference, citing the SDK v12.0 note or the season file

assertions.name: no-decode-pattern-endorsement
assertions.text: Does not endorse the approach by citing a DECODE-season AprilTag relocalization pattern as current evidence
